notes: Adds quantity-based accessory tracking so identical magazines and other bulk accessories can be represented by one record.
Adds reusable accessory compatibility groups based on firearm models, explicit firearm overrides, and optional per-firearm quantity allocation.
Preserves dedicated one-accessory-to-one-firearm assignment history for individual accessories.
Fixes the sidebar Viewing selector with a functional All Users / person menu, persistence, and owner/shared collection filtering.
